c.description: array_like Array of Laguerre series coefficients. If `c` is multidimensional the different axis correspond to different variables with the degree in each axis given by the corresponding index.
constraints: If c is multidimensional, the different axis correspond to different variables with the degree in each axis given by the corresponding index.
c, m, scl, axis are all optional parameters.

m.description: int, optional Number of derivatives taken, must be non-negative. (Default: 1)
constraints: c, m, scl, axis are all optional parameters.

scl.description: scalar, optional Each differentiation is multiplied by `scl`. The end result is multiplication by ``scl**m``. This is for use in a linear change of variable. (Default: 1)
constraints: c, m, scl, axis are all optional parameters.

axis.description: int, optional Axis over which the derivative is taken. (Default: 0).
constraints: c, m, scl, axis are all optional parameters.

output.description: ------- ndarray Laguerre series of the derivative.

constraints: c, m, scl, axis are all optional parameters.
